items.description: Perfecto is a web application that allows users to sell and buy used bikes, with knowledge of the sellers and buyers. Perfecto partners with Strava which gives users information about the history of the bikes for sale and build a rapport between seller and buyer. This application uses the Bike Index API.

FullContact provides a suite of tools to support individuals, businesses, and developers in managing and enhancing their contact data. The FullContact Person API allows applications to lookup information about a specific person by connecting data keys associated with a person’s email address, hashed email address, phone number, social handle (twitter, instagram, facebook) or vCard and returning a complete customer profile. To get started, sign up for a free API Key.
